REASON FOR VISIT: Follow-up for hypothyroidism, 6 weeks after levothyroxine dose increase.

INTERVAL HISTORY: Patient reports improved energy, no palpitations, no heat intolerance.

PHYSICAL EXAM: No tremor, heart regular rate and rhythm, no thyromegaly.

PLAN: Continue levothyroxine at current dose. Recheck TSH in 6 weeks. Follow up after labs.
